_about: Tram and buses (engine/fetch_surface.py, engine/surface.py) from RTA's GTFS, downloaded by hand from Data Dubai (dataset 464468; it answers only UAE addresses, so Actions can't fetch it): 'file' is the zip in raw/gtfs2026/ (gitignored). The Metro's Red and Green lines join for the Routes page only ('rapid'); the map draws them from its own layer (transit.py), with the tram and the marine routes. RTA publishes no live feed, so the Routes page shows timetable times ('sched').
